about.title: About HBR Electronics
about.body: Established in 2009, HONGBAIRONG (HBR) is a professional manufacturer and exporter focused on mobile phone accessories, LCD modules, optoelectronic components and electronic parts. With over 15 years of OEM & ODM experience, our factory in Dongguan, Guangdong sits close to Shenzhen port for efficient global logistics. We serve wholesalers, distributors, repair shops and brand buyers across Europe, America, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa.
